description: Task 3.3 Advanced Filtering. Add five new event filters that implement the existing EventFilter trait in xplainit-core/src/filter.rs: TimeRangeFilter, ValueFilter, FrequencyFilter (sampling), PathFilter, and UserFilter (custom predicate). Extend the existing filter abstraction rather than inventing a parallel one. This is ordered before the async work because it is self-contained and lower-risk.
steps: Re-read xplainit-core/src/filter.rs to confirm the EventFilter trait signature: `fn should_capture(&self, event: &ExecutionEvent, config: &Config) -> bool;` and `fn description(&self) -> String;`. New filters implement THIS trait so they compose with CompositeFilter.

TimeRangeFilter: capture only events whose event.timestamp() falls within an inclusive [start, end] window (use chrono DateTime<Utc>, already a dependency). Support open-ended bounds (Option<DateTime<Utc>> for start and/or end). should_capture returns true when the timestamp is within bounds.

ValueFilter: capture events whose associated value(s) match a configured pattern. Inspect the Value payloads reachable from an event (e.g. VariableAssign new_value/old_value, VariableDeclaration value, FunctionExit return_value, TypeError value, FunctionEnter args). Support matching by substring on the rendered value and/or by Value variant/type_name(). Events with no inspectable value should pass through by default (configurable) so the filter does not silently drop unrelated events.

FrequencyFilter: sample high-frequency events. MUST be deterministic and counter-based (the `rand` crate is NOT available offline). Follow the existing PerformanceFilter::should_sample pattern in advanced_filter.rs (capture 1 in N by an internal counter). Because EventFilter::should_capture takes &self (not &mut self), use interior mutability (std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize or a Mutex) for the counter so the trait signature is preserved. Allow an optional per-event-type sampling so e.g. LoopIteration can be sampled while errors are always kept.

PathFilter: include/exclude events by execution path / file path. Use event.location().file and support include globs/substrings and exclude globs/substrings, mirroring the simple glob approach already in advanced_filter.rs ModuleFilter (replace ** -> .+, * -> [^/\]+). Exclusions win over inclusions.

UserFilter: wrap a user-provided predicate closure `Box<dyn Fn(&ExecutionEvent, &Config) -> bool + Send + Sync>`. Provide a constructor taking the closure. description() returns a static label. This gives callers arbitrary custom filtering while still implementing EventFilter.
Re-export the five new filter types from xplainit-core/src/lib.rs alongside the existing `pub use filter::{...}` list.

Add thorough #[cfg(test)] tests in filter.rs for each new filter following the existing test style (construct ExecutionEvent values with uuid::Uuid::new_v4(), chrono::Utc::now(), SourceLocation, HashMap). Cover: TimeRange in/out of window and open bounds; ValueFilter match vs no-match vs no-value passthrough; FrequencyFilter deterministic 1-in-N sequence; PathFilter include/exclude/glob; UserFilter with a real predicate. Each test must fail if the filter logic were reverted/removed.
Keep clippy clean (-D warnings) and run cargo fmt.
acceptance_criteria: TimeRangeFilter, ValueFilter, FrequencyFilter, PathFilter, UserFilter all implement the EventFilter trait and compose inside CompositeFilter.
FrequencyFilter uses deterministic counter-based sampling with interior mutability and adds no new external dependency (no rand).
All five types are re-exported from lib.rs.
New tests in filter.rs cover each filter's accept and reject paths and pass under `cargo test`.
cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, and cargo fmt --all -- --check all pass.
findings: Added five filters to xplainit-core/src/filter.rs, all implementing the existing EventFilter trait so they compose in CompositeFilter: TimeRangeFilter (inclusive Option<DateTime<Utc>> bounds, open-ended when None), ValueFilter (substring on rendered value and/or Value::type_name(), with configurable pass_without_value for events carrying no inspectable value; inspects VariableAssign/VariableDeclaration/FunctionExit/Return/TypeError/DivisionByZero/LoopIteration/FunctionEnter payloads), FrequencyFilter (deterministic 1-in-N counter using AtomicUsize interior mutability since should_capture takes &self, with always_keep_type and always_keep_errors bypasses), PathFilter (include/exclude substring + simple glob via the ModuleFilter ** -> .+ / * -> [^/\\]+ / ? -> . approach, exclusions win), and UserFilter (wraps a Box<dyn Fn(&ExecutionEvent,&Config)->bool + Send + Sync>; added a UserPredicate type alias to satisfy clippy::type_complexity). Added a private render_value helper (Value has no Display impl) that sorts object entries for deterministic output. Re-exported all five types plus UserPredicate is left unexported (internal alias) from lib.rs. Added 13 new #[cfg(test)] tests covering accept/reject/open-bound/passthrough/deterministic-sampling/glob/composite cases. No new dependencies added (chrono/regex already present; no rand). Verified: cargo build --release, cargo test (all crates green), cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings (clean), cargo fmt --all -- --check (clean).
